text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer! I got plenty of rest and I'm feeling amped!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Actually, I took advantage of the break to run all the way to the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! There's no better feeling than running toward the wide open sea!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: On top of that, I got to shout my dreams at the sunset! It was the best break ever!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now I'm ready to throw myself back into training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Bamboo Memory had a very productive break.
